content.text:
Okay, it clicked. Account at פסגות, fund ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500. I've heard of פסגות. Done here.

**What I decided:** I'd open a trading account at פסגות ניירות ערך and put 750 ₪ a month into "ילין לפידות מחקה (4D) S&P 500". The page says after 15 years I'd have about **179,889 ₪ "בכסף של היום"**, after fees and tax. I'd put in 135,000 ₪ of my own. On inflation, the page assumes **2% a year**. I'm fairly sure. What decided it: the page marked that pair "★ הזול", the cheapest, and I know the name פסגות.

**How it went:**
- The heading "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד" told me straight away I was in the right place. I typed 0, 750 and 15 into the boxes and that worked first try.
- To check inflation I tapped the "אינפלציה" button. A small window opened with "אינפלציה בשנה: 2%". I only found it because the task told me to look. On the main screen it's just a grey button. Next to it there's a line about "שער הדולר 3.17 ₪" and a European central bank, and I skipped that.
- I scrolled once. There's a coloured bar chart titled "כמה זה עולה לכם ב־15 שנים". The total was 18,299 ₪. The big pink part, 15,364, I guessed is tax. The yellow 2,002 I think is the account fee. I only glanced at the legend, so those are guesses.
- After that, the fund box and the account box, with "דמי ניהול 0%" and the fund number.

**Words I didn't get:** "דמי משמרת", "נאמן 0.02%", "עסקת החלף", "צוברת", "מנוטרלת מט״ח", "קרן חוץ בת״א", "4D".

**Where I hesitated:**
- "בכסף של היום" next to the 179,889. I think it means inflation is already taken off, but I'm not 100% sure.
- "אם הדולר לא זז מול השקל" sits right under the big number. That's a condition I can't judge.
- The next pair is only 122 ₪ worse, also פסגות, and it looks almost the same. That made me unsure whether it even matters which one I pick.
- The row of fund-type tags (צוברת 16, חשיפה לדולר 19...) has way too many options. If the page hadn't put a star on one, I'd have closed it.

**What I'd change:** Show "2% אינפלציה" right next to the big number instead of hiding it behind a button. Also explain the tags in plain words, or hide them.
